source_caption:
Do you agree with this?

Keanu Reeves and Winona Ryder carry the entire movie with their sharp, cynical banter, making Destination Wedding (2018) stand out from traditional, lighthearted romantic comedies. Instead of relying on usual genre tropes, it plays out almost like a stage play driven entirely by their shared pessimism and reluctant chemistry.

While promoting this film, Winona Ryder claimed that she and Keanu Reeves might actually have been married to each other in real life when they filmed the marriage scene in Dracula (1992), because a real Romanian Orthodox priest was used. Francis Ford Coppola, who directed that film, agreed that this could be true.

source_details.title: Destination Wedding
source_details.synopsis: Destination Wedding is a 2018 American romantic comedy-drama film written and directed by Victor Levin. It stars Winona Ryder and Keanu Reeves as two people who meet while attending the same wedding in Paso Robles, California. It was released in the United States on August 31, 2018.
